name: Brian Bollinger
bio: Brian is the licensed reviewer for BestInsurance Research and a producer at WJB Services, Inc. dba Bollinsure Insurance Services. Review means checking that the insurance substance of a page is accurate, that its limits are stated honestly, and that nothing on it reads as individualized advice or as a coverage determination.
scope: Reviews insurance terminology, form behavior, and stated limitations before publication.
Confirms that a page does not give legal, tax, or claims advice and does not decide eligibility.
Signs off on the confidence status assigned to each answer.
Review is an editorial function. It does not create a broker relationship with any reader and does not convert general information into advice.
